newsitem.title: UK: Vosper close to 700 mln Gulf order.
newsitem.headline: Vosper close to 700 mln Gulf order.

text.p: Vosper Thorneycroft Plc is close to winning a 700 million stg ($1.14 billion) order from the United Arab Emirates and is in the running for a 27-ship deal with Malaysia that could be worth 2 billion stg, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.

It said the UAE order could be announced as early as March and would transform Vosper's order book, which was worth 400 million stg in December. Three of the company's four big contracts end within two years, the paper said.
Last year defence secretary Michael Portillo signed a co-operation pact with the UAE, clearing the way for Vosper to bid for the contract, the Sunday Times said.
No-one at Vosper was available for comment.
